team_notes.BAL: Jacoby Brissett starts while Lamar (thumb, IR) and Huntley (toe, out for season) are out (RotoBaller Nov 20). CB Marlon Humphrey sent home and won't play Wk11 (Yahoo NFL live, Nov 19).
team_notes.SEA: Week 11 bye. Darnold 'on track to return' after the bye and keeps the job (RotoBaller Nov 20).
team_notes.CLE: Browns plan to start Watson vs HOU (ESPN source, Nov 9); Monken not confirmed. Sanders 297 yds in Wk9.
team_notes.MIN: Cousins starts; Kyler Murray (hamstring) OUT (CBS Nov 20). Hockenson full Friday, no designation; Addison OUT.
team_notes.KC: Kenneth Walker III (groin) OUT; rookie Emmett Johnson starts for the second straight week (AP Nov 20). RG Trey Smith and RT Jaylon Moore OUT.
team_notes.LAC: Herbert avoided a finger fracture (NFL.com, Nov 9); McConkey scratched Wk9 (back).
team_notes.GB: Josh Jacobs fractured a finger (right hand) in Wk9 (Nov 8).
team_notes.NE: Stevenson (knee) imaging; A.J. Brown expected to travel to Germany, no decision; RG Ben Brown not traveling (Vrabel, Nov 9).
team_notes.DEN: Jonah Coleman the clear lead back after 58 of 75 snaps in Wk9 (Draft Sharks, Nov 9); Harvey and Badie on IR. Wk10 bye.
team_notes.CHI: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) says he's 'on track' to return Wk11 after five missed games (Forbes Nov 16); Burden (concussion) practiced Mon (Big Lead Nov 17).
team_notes.ARI: Josh Johnson (40) expected to start vs KC: LaFleur 'we're going to proceed as if Josh is going to be starting'; Beck (back spasms) DNP Fri, 'doesn't sound hopeful' (Cards Wire Nov 20). Allgeier/Knight committee. Beck downgraded to OUT Sat; Josh Johnson starts (NFL.com Nov 21).
team_notes.NYJ: Geno Smith full Friday, cleared to start at LAC (CBS Nov 20). Omar Cooper Jr. OUT.
team_notes.NYG: Skattebo had all 18 RB carries in the Wk10 TNF game (box score, Nov 12).
team_notes.HOU: Official TNF report (NFL.com, Nov 19): Woody Marks (concussion), Harrison Jr. (hamstring), Brevin Jordan (TE) OUT; David Montgomery no designation (full practice), Tank Dell full. Stroud starts. Montgomery the lead back: Ryans 'trending toward playing' (Houston Chronicle via FantasyFootballers Nov 17); Demercado 'expected to serve as the top complement to David Montgomery' (FantasyFootballers news, Nov 19).
team_notes.LV: Brock Bowers (ankle) DNP Wed, limited Thu Nov 19 (ESPN via RotoWire); Kubiak Nov 18: doesn't need to practice to play. Mendoza starts.
team_notes.PIT: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) remains on IR, not expected vs PHI (ESPN via NFL.com Saturday roundup Nov 21) - supersedes the Nov 20 Questionable note. Roman Wilson (hand) activated from IR Nov 21.
team_notes.IND: Keenan Allen and Josh Downs traded; Treadwell de facto WR1 (RotoBaller Nov 17). TNF report (NFL.com Nov 19): LT Raimann (concussion), T Jalen Travis, TE Will Mallory OUT; T Charlie Heck questionable (personal).
team_notes.DET: Aidan Hutchinson torn ACL, out for the season (Big Lead Nov 17).
team_notes.TB: Mayfield (foot/thumb) Questionable after limited Thu and Fri; Bowles: 'trending in the right direction' (NFL.com Nov 20). Modeled 60% Mayfield / 40% Jalon Daniels. Winfield Jr. OUT. Sat Nov 21: Mayfield expected to play (Pelissero via Yahoo live blog); modeled 85/15.
team_notes.TEN: Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) on IR, out for the season (Saleh Nov 18). Carnell Tate (shoulder) and Tyjae Spears limited Thu Nov 19 (official report). Tyjae Spears (knee) placed on IR Nov 21; Carnell Tate expected back (full Fri; Yahoo Nov 21); RB Michael Carter elevated (NFL.com Nov 21).
team_notes.PHI: Joe Milton III starts vs PIT. DeVonta Smith full all week, no designation; Wicks OUT; LB Zack Baun OUT (Nov 20 report). Sat Nov 21: Wicks and Baun to IR, Will Shipley activated (Garafolo via ClutchPoints).
team_notes.SF: Mike Evans (Achilles tendinitis) Questionable, expected to play (Garafolo, NFL.com Sat Nov 21). Game in Mexico City.
team_notes.BUF: TE Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) Doubtful, DNP all week (Nov 20 report).
team_notes.WAS: Rachaad White (heel) expected to be good for Monday (Quinn); Croskey-Merritt (groin) trending toward playing (NFL.com Saturday roundup Nov 21). Croskey-Merritt expected back from IR as the 'preferred top option' in a committee with White and Ekeler (Yahoo/Heavy Nov 21); White's role 'will likely shrink' (RotoWire Nov 21). lead_back 0.50.
team_notes.CAR: Jonathon Brooks not activated, OUT vs BAL; Canales: ball goes to Chuba Hubbard (Panthers Wire Nov 21).
